a: IaaS provides virtual machines, storage, and networking (infrastructure as a service).
PaaS provides a platform to deploy apps without managing servers (e.g. Render, Heroku-style).
Serverless/FaaS runs functions on demand without managing servers continuously.
AWS is Amazon Web Services, a major cloud provider.
Microsoft Azure is Microsoft's cloud platform.
A container packages an app with its dependencies for consistent runs everywhere.
A Docker image is a read-only template used to create containers.
A Dockerfile lists instructions to build a Docker image.
Continuous Integration automatically builds and tests code on every change.
Continuous Delivery/Deployment automates releasing tested code to environments.
IaC manages servers and cloud resources with code (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.).
Terraform is a popular tool for infrastructure as code across cloud providers.
Observability means understanding systems via logs, metrics, and traces.
Prometheus is a metrics monitoring and alerting system.
Grafana visualizes metrics and logs with dashboards.
Blue-green deployment switches traffic between two identical environments for safer releases.
Canary deployment rolls out a change to a small % of users first.
